name: Radio
purpose: Select exactly one option from a mutually exclusive set.
intent: Native radio input behavior with shared LegacyHQ styling, almost always composed through RadioGroup for grouping, shared name management, and accessible labeling.

figmaSource.note: This file documents two components (Radio, RadioGroup) - Figma confirms the same split, recorded separately below.

useCases: Selecting one option from a short, fully-visible set of mutually exclusive choices
Form questions with a single correct answer
Settings and preferences where only one choice applies
Label-less row selection in a table, described by an adjacent aria-label
antiPatterns: Long lists needing scroll or search (use Select or Combobox)
A single, immediate on/off setting (use Switch)
Hand-wiring shared name/selection state across standalone Radio instances instead of using RadioGroup

label.description: Visible label. Omit only when aria-label/aria-labelledby is set.

required.description: Maps to native required. Appends a visible required indicator after the label.

className.description: Composes with the root label's class list.

inputClassName.description: Composes with the native input's class list.

anatomy: legend / group label (with optional required indicator)
options (from the options prop, or children)

label.description: Rendered as the fieldset legend; the group's accessible name.

errorMessage.description: Connected to the fieldset with aria-describedby when present.

name.description: Shared across every option generated from options. Auto-generated when omitted.

options.description: Generates one Radio per entry. Takes precedence over children when provided.

children.description: Custom layout of manually-wired Radio instances. Used only when options is omitted.

orientation.description: horizontal wraps via flex-wrap rather than overflowing.

required.description: Group-level required indicator, shown after the legend.

invalid.description: Sets aria-invalid on the fieldset and every generated option.

disabled.description: Disables the fieldset and every generated option.

accessibility.grouping: fieldset/legend via RadioGroup when a group label is provided
accessibility.ariaInvalid: set on the input (Radio) or the fieldset (RadioGroup) when invalid
accessibility.ariaDescribedBy: connects RadioGroup's description/errorMessage to the fieldset
doNotUse: role="radiogroup" in place of a native fieldset

keyboardInteraction: Tab moves focus into and out of the group as a single stop
Arrow keys move selection between options sharing the same name (native browser behavior)
behaviorRules: Only one option is selected within a group of radios sharing the same name.
Radio's onCheckedChange fires when the input changes; checked enables controlled usage, defaultChecked enables uncontrolled usage.
RadioGroup passes a shared name to every Radio generated from options.
RadioGroup is controlled via value/onValueChange and uncontrolled via defaultValue.
RadioGroup renders generated options from options when provided; otherwise renders children.
A disabled RadioGroup disables every option generated from options.
required on RadioGroup applies at the group/question level, not per option.
compositionRules: Radio is almost always used inside RadioGroup rather than standalone.
The Figma radio-item part remains private anatomy and is not exported as a public component.
RadioGroup supports the options API for a standard list, or children for a custom layout of manually-wired Radio instances.
contentRules: Labels should be concise and unique within a group.
Required indicator appears after the label/legend text.
RadioGroup's label should name the accessible question or prompt, not an individual option.
responsiveRules: RadioGroup orientation is vertical by default with no gap between options.
orientation="horizontal" wraps via flex-wrap once the container is too narrow, rather than overflowing.
themeRules: Works in light and dark themes; no primitive color references.
implementationNotes: Decorative RadioCheckedIcon/RadioUncheckedIcon swapped via CSS on the :checked selector, not conditional rendering.
Shared Focus Ring primitive utility classes for the focus-visible ring.
Radio predates the shared data-force-state convention used by Checkbox/Button/Avatar - hover, press, and focus previews use previewHover/previewPress/previewFocus classes instead.
Do not add radio control shapes to the shared icon library beyond the existing RadioCheckedIcon/RadioUncheckedIcon.
Do not use the browser default radio appearance or an SVG-only input.
do: Use for mutually exclusive choices, composed inside RadioGroup.
Use RadioGroup's options API for a straightforward list; children for a custom layout.
Give RadioGroup an accessible group name via label.
Pair invalid with a visible errorMessage or aria-describedby.
dont: Use for multiple independent selections - use Checkbox instead.
Hand-wire shared name/selection state across standalone Radio instances when options already does it.
Rely on the invalid color alone to communicate a validation problem.
acceptanceCriteria: Native input[type="radio"] semantics are preserved - no ARIA role recreation.
Keyboard accessible through native browser radio-group behavior.
Visible focus uses the shared Focus Ring primitive.
Exactly one option is selected within a group sharing the same name.
RadioGroup supports both controlled and uncontrolled usage.
RadioGroup supports both the options API and children composition.
No hardcoded colors, radii, border widths, or spacing values.
